messages:
alex_chan: Quick sync — finalizing the SDK v2.4 release. We need a quick ownership matrix: who owns pkg release, docs changelog, sample apps bump, and quickstart deploy. cc @maria_k @danielle

maria_k: I can do the docs changelog + website copy. Planning to cut the changelog PR by EOD PDT. Need final list of breaking changes from eng runtime.

danielle: I’ll own the npm/pypi packaging and release process. I need the exact tag we should use and any post-release migration notes.

priya_s: I’ll take sample apps and quickstarts. Will update the sample-app repo, run smoke tests, and push new docker tags. ETA tomorrow morning.

jordan_ml: Runtime team: we have a small tweak that changes the client config env var name (REDWOOD_CACHE -> REDWOOD_KV_CACHE). Not a code-breaking change if you map both envs for one release. Will send a short migration note.

alex_chan: Good catch. danielle — recommend we publish a minor with deprecation warning in the client, then next major flips. For this release, include mapping logic so sample apps don't break.

maria_k: can you paste the exact env var names here, jordan? I'll add to the changelog snippet.

jordan_ml: sure: old=REDWOOD_CACHE, new=REDWOOD_KV_CACHE. Sample apps should read new then fallback to old:

```js
const cacheEnv = process.env.REDWOOD_KV_CACHE || process.env.REDWOOD_CACHE;
```

priya_s: copying that into sample apps now. Will run e2e locally. If anyone has a canary cluster I can push to, ping me.

danielle: tagging strategy: we'll create git tag v2.4.0 on main after changelog PR merged. Release script: `./scripts/release.sh v2.4.0` — it runs build -> test -> publish. CI must be green before tagging.

ci-bot: CI: tests failing on samples e2e (timeout on auth flow). See: https://ci.example.com/build/4482 — job 5 failed.

priya_s: I see the e2e flake, repro locally. Looks like an intermittent auth redirect. Adding a retry and increasing timeout on the test. Will push a fix in a hot PR.

alex_chan: We have a hard changelog cutoff at 2026-05-03 23:59 PDT for release notes. Anything after goes to next release. maria, please prepare the release notes page draft by then.

maria_k: noted. Can you add any product impact bullets? I’ll draft and post link for review.

alex_chan: High-level bullets: env var mapping, client deprecation warning, improved batching perf, docs for Dedicated autoscaling policy. Add them to the changelog draft.

jordan_ml: I'll add the batching perf numbers (p50/p95) to the notes by EOD.

danielle: small ask — can someone approve my packaging PR (#812) for the minor version. It unblocks npm/pypi publish.

alex_chan: I’ll review in 30m. If green, merge and then CI should trigger release pipeline. Remember to attach the release checklist in PR description: publish checklist, tag, announce channels.

priya_s: pushed sample-app fixes -> PR #159, updated Docker tag naming to include platform matrix. Also added fallback for env var. Waiting on CI.

ci-bot: CI: PR #159 — all checks passed.

priya_s: can someone approve sample app PR? Would like to merge and run canary.

maria_k: approving now :thumbsup:

danielle: packaging PR merged. Kicking off release script locally to verify artifacts.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary deploy to dev-canary cluster started by danielle at 2026-05-02T04:30:12Z. Status: in-progress.

alex_chan: timeline check — goal is to be fully released by 2026-05-04 morning — that gives 24h of monitoring after canary. If any regression, we roll back.

jordan_ml: monitoring hooks added to Console dashboard. I’ll watch latency/cost signals and alert if p95 > 750ms or unit cost delta > 10%.

maria_k: changelog draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/notes/sdk-2-4-changelog — added bullets and migration snippet. Please comment by EOD.

danielle: artifacts look good locally. After canary stability check, I’ll run `./scripts/release.sh v2.4.0` from CI context. Who will post the announcement in #announcements?

alex_chan: I will post the public announcement and product digest. Maria, can you prepare the internal release note for sales & support?

maria_k: on it. I’ll include migration steps and sample app links.

priya_s: canary healthy after 2 hours. No errors in auth flow. Smoke tests green.

jordan_ml: saw a small p50 improvement in batching, p95 unchanged. No regressions. Looks good to me.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary deploy completed successfully. Stable for 2 hours.

alex_chan: green across the board. danielle — proceed with the final tag and release. Remember to add the changelog PR number in the release body.

danielle: tagging and publishing now: `git tag -a v2.4.0 -m "SDK v2.4.0" && git push origin v2.4.0`

ci-bot: Release pipeline started for tag v2.4.0. Artifacts uploading...

ci-bot: Release pipeline succeeded. Published npm package @redwood/sdk v2.4.0 and pypi package redwood-sdk 2.4.0

maria_k: release notes merged and announced internally. Public docs updated and sample-apps repo bumped.

alex_chan: awesome — thanks everyone. If anyone spots a regression, create an incident channel and ping eng-oncall. Otherwise I’ll mark this thread as done and archive the checklist. :tada:

priya_s: great work team!

danielle: thanks all, closing release checklist.

last message: alex_chan: archived release checklist in docs, closing thread.
